title: 🏭 Sun Prairie Manufacturing - Multiple Full-Time Roles Open Now
text:
1 days ago Sun Prairie’s manufacturing scene is busy right now, with solid options whether you’re new to warehouse work or already skilled on machines.
Here are several full-time roles worth a look:
Order Pickers – Day and Afternoon Shift Employer: Employbridge (for a client in Sun Prairie, WI ) Type: Full-time, evaluation-to-hire Pay: $17/hr (1st shift) , $18/hr (2nd shift) , overtime after 40 hrs Shifts: 1st: Mon–Fri, 8am–5pm (times may vary with workload) 2nd: Mon–Thu, 11am–8pm; Fri, 9:30am–6:30pm Picker/packer role using an RF scanner to pull orders, package, label, and move product. Weekly pay, medical/dental/vision and retirement from day 1 , plus free online manufacturing classes and a referral bonus . Warehouse experience helps, but they’ll train; you’ll be on your feet and lifting up to 50 lbs.
Warehouse Operations Employer: The Home Depot Location: Sun Prairie Town, WI (Distribution Center) Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Support the distribution center by helping keep equipment running, inventory accurate, and safety and asset protection processes on track. Good fit if you like detail work, solving problems, and working across teams to keep a big operation running smoothly.
